title: The ordinary module class equals abelian sheafification after extension by zero
statement: Let X,Y be schemes, D any additive functor from module sheaves on X to module sheaves on Y, L any nonnegative cochain complex on X, q a natural number and V an open of Y. Put F=abelian presheaf sections, P=D⋙F, E=evaluation at V, Γ=P⋙E, B=D(L), and J=D(L extended by zero to integers). Let a identify H^q(ΓL) with E(H^q(P(L extended))) by inverse extendHomologyIso, inverse mapExtendIso and exact evaluation; let d identify H^q(J) with H^q(B) by mapExtendIso and extendHomologyIso. Then the exact evaluation comparison followed by sectionCohomologyTheta(B,q) at V equals a.hom followed by the abelian sheafification unit at H^q(FJ), the underlying map of localSectionComplexSheafificationIso(Y,q,J), and F(d.hom), all evaluated at V. The maps are as in [def-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-open-choices] and [lem-trf-unbounded-direct-image-section-presheaf]. This has no derived-category or acyclicity hypothesis.

proof.text: Apply the ordinary abelian sheafification cycle calculation to J=D(L extended). This identifies the abelian class map with the quotient of the same module cycles used by the module class map.

Use homologyπ_extendHomologyIso_inv and homologyπ_naturality to transport cycles across extension by zero and mapExtendIso. Exact evaluation commutes with the cycle and homology comparisons. The degree-q components of mapExtendIso and extendXIso agree, since q is in the image of embeddingUpNat; their products are identities.

Precompose both sides by the epimorphic cycle-to-homology projection. Apply the module cycle formula to the left and the ordinary abelian cycle formula to the right. Their remaining cycle maps agree by cancellation of the monic cycle inclusion. Cancel the cycle projection. This includes q=0, empty opens, and zero complexes.

theorem nonnegativeComplex_localClass {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (D : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) ⥤
      SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) [D.Additive]
    (L : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℕ)
    (q : ℕ) (V : Y.Opens) :
    let P := D ⋙ RingedSpace.localAbelianSections Y.toRingedSpace
    letI : P.Additive := inferInstanceAs
      (D ⋙ RingedSpace.localAbelianSections Y.toRingedSpace).Additive
    let E := (CategoryTheory.evaluation Y.Opensᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj (op V)
    let Γ := P ⋙ E
    letI : Γ.Additive := inferInstanceAs (P ⋙ E).Additive
    let B := (D.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj L
    let a :=
      (((Γ.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj L).extendHomologyIso
        ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat (j := q) rfl).symm ≪≫
      (HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (ComplexShape.up ℤ)
        (q : ℤ)).mapIso (L.mapExtendIso ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat Γ).symm ≪≫
      (((P.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
        (L.extend ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat)).sc (q : ℤ)).mapHomologyIso E
    let J := (D.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
      (L.extend ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat)
    let d :=
      (HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (q : ℤ)).mapIso
        (L.mapExtendIso ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat D) ≪≫
      B.extendHomologyIso ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat (j := q) rfl
    (((((SheafOfModules.forget Y.ringCatSheaf).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj B).sc q).mapHomologyIso
        (PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf Y.ringCatSheaf.obj ⋙ E)).hom ≫
        ((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf Y.ringCatSheaf.obj).map
          (sectionCohomologyTheta B q)).app (op V) =
      a.hom ≫
        ((sheafificationAdjunction (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).unit.app
          (((RingedSpace.localAbelianSections Y.toRingedSpace).mapHomologicalComplex
            (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj J |>.homology (q : ℤ))).app (op V) ≫
        ((sheafToPresheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).map
          (RingedSpace.localSectionComplexSheafificationIso Y.toRingedSpace (q : ℤ) J).hom).app
            (op V) ≫
        ((RingedSpace.localAbelianSections Y.toRingedSpace).map d.hom).app (op V)
